scripts.dev: npm run sync-engine && npm run sync-cells && vite
scripts.build: npm run sync-engine && npm run sync-cells && tsc && vite build && npm run check-engine
scripts.sync-engine:
rm -rf public/engine && mkdir -p public/engine && cp -R ../../dist/npm-eda/. public/engine/ && node -e "const fs=require('fs');if(!fs.existsSync('public/engine/Design.mjs')||!fs.existsSync('public/engine/veneer/design.mjs')){console.error('
  engine lacks the Design bridge or veneer — rebuild:
  NUCLEATION_WASM_FEATURES=bridge,simulation,mc-tick,routing,hdl,meshing ./tools/package-npm.sh dist/npm-eda
');process.exit(1)}" && node scripts/engine-stamp.mjs --write
